name: Bone Chewer
description: A hunched, feral creature with serrated teeth and powerful jaws.
motives_and_tactics: Bone Chewers swarm wounded prey, targeting whoever is most vulnerable. They retreat when their numbers drop below half.

feats.name: Pack Tactics
feats.text: This adversary deals +1 damage for each other Bone Chewer within Very Close range of the target.

name: Ironguard Soldier
description: A disciplined mercenary in battered plate armour, veteran of a dozen campaigns.
motives_and_tactics: Ironguards form defensive lines and advance methodically, protecting their leader. They fight until ordered to retreat.

feats.name: Shield Wall
feats.text: While adjacent to another Ironguard Soldier, this adversary reduces all incoming damage by 1.

feats.name: Rallying Cry
feats.text: Once per encounter, this adversary may spend a Fear to grant all allied Ironguard Soldiers within Close range +2 to their next attack roll.

name: Thornwood Archer
description: A lithe scout who moves through underbrush like smoke, loosing arrows from shadows.
motives_and_tactics: Thornwood Archers stay at range, repositioning each turn. They target spellcasters and anyone not wearing heavy armour.

feats.name: Vanish
feats.text: When this adversary moves, it may become Hidden until it attacks or takes an action.

feats.name: Pinning Shot
feats.text: On a successful attack, the target's movement is halved until the end of their next turn.

name: Warlord Keth
description: A scarred half-giant general who commands through fear and tactical genius.
motives_and_tactics: Keth stays behind her soldiers, directing the battlefield with bellowed commands. She enters melee only when cornered, then fights with terrifying ferocity.

feats.name: Battlefield Command
feats.text: At the start of each round, Keth may grant one allied adversary an additional action this round.

feats.name: Crushing Blow
feats.text: When Keth hits with an attack, she may spend 2 Fear to deal an additional 1d10 damage and knock the target Prone.

feats.name: Indomitable
feats.text: The first time Keth would be reduced to 0 HP, she instead drops to 1 HP and becomes Enraged, gaining +2 to all attacks until the end of the encounter.
